data.gender_notes: Palomi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who holds the lotus in her hand. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'palā' meaning lotus and 'omi' meaning in hand. The name Palomi carries the meaning “Lotus in hand” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Palomi usually hope their child will grow to embody lotus in hand and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Palomi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lotus in hand.”

data.cultural_impact: The lotus is a significant symbol in Hinduism, representing purity, divine creativity, detachment, and enlightenment. The fact that Palomi is named after this sacred flower emphasizes her connection to the divine and her potential to embody spiritual values in her daily life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Palomi carries great spiritual significance as it symbolizes the Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth, prosperity, fortune, and the embodiment of purity, generosity, and beauty. By invoking this divine name, the bearer of the name is reminded to carry the qualities of Lakshmi within herself – generosity, purity, and abundance – and to strive to bring these qualities to the world around her.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Palomi is believed to originate from the Sanskrit words "Pala" meaning protection and "Momi" meaning mother. This name symbolizes the nurturing and protective energies of a mother, providing strength and comfort to her child. It is a name that inspires a sense of safety and security, embodying the unconditional love and care of a mother.

historical_references.reference: Palomi was a prominent queen of the Maurya Empire, ruling around 321-273 BCE. She was the wife of Emperor Ashoka, who ruled from 268-232 BCE.
Palomi was also the name of a legendary princess mentioned in the Hindu epic, the Mahabharata. She was the wife of Bhishma, the grandsire of the Pandava and Kaurava princes.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Palomi, of Hindu origin, holds a modern context in various spheres. In the realm of Indian art and culture, Palomi is associated with intricate traditional designs and patterns, reflecting the rich heritage of the Indian subcontinent. In contemporary fashion, the name Palomi is used for unique and stylish clothing lines, showcasing a fusion of Indian and Western styles. In the digital media and marketing sector, Palomi is a popular name for various brands, blogs, and social media influencers, promoting a diverse range of products and services.
